title: iShares Core S&P 500 ETF Experiences Big Inflow
text: iShares Core S&P 500 ETF Experiences Big Inflow January 16, 2018, 10:53:59   iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (Symbol: IVV)   $2.6 billion dollar inflow -- that's a 1.7% increase week over week in outstanding units (from 530,550,000 to 539,800,000). Among the largest underlying components of IVV, in trading today Apple Inc (Symbol: AAPL) is up about 1.1%, Microsoft Corporation (Symbol: MSFT) is up about 0.9%, and Facebook Inc (Symbol: FB) is up by about 0.3%. For a complete list of holdings, visit the IVV Holdings page »   IVV,   IVV's low point in its 52 week range is $226.66 per share, with $282.15   $281.64.
